author: nerfgun2002
body:
Dear Avicus Staff,
I think that there is a misunderstanding. I don't understand why am I ban for ban evading. It says banned for Ban evading (BryanHuen). Firstly, I just got unbanned, why would I be ban evading. BryanHuen is not even my account too! Just because you think its the same ip,Its my brothers account and I don't use it. I was just playing team fortress 2 and I when I want to come onto avicus I found out I got banned. What is this misunderstanding here? Please look into this matter and take the appropriate actions on the moderator who banned me. Please give me proof other than ip adress.

replies.author: Mango_
replies.body:
Hello,

We have evidence that the nerfgun2002 and BryanHuen accounts share the same IP. If are are able to, please provide proof that BryanHuen is your brother's account. Ban evading is taken quite seriously and can significantly lower your chances of appealing in the future.
